keyEvents.text: Goal! Mijas Las Lagunas 0, Real Jaén 1. Fran Gallego (Real Jaén) with an attempt from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
David Montejano (Real Jaén) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Cristóbal Jiménez González (Mijas Las Lagunas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Antonio Caballero (Real Jaén) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ricardo Wolfgang Wagner Burgos (Mijas Las Lagunas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Adrián Peral (Mijas Las Lagunas) Substitution at 57'
Francisco Ariza López (Mijas Las Lagunas) Substitution at 57'
Goal! Mijas Las Lagunas 0, Real Jaén 2. Mouhamadou Keita (Real Jaén) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Diego Fuentes (Real Jaen CF) Substitution at 64'
Daniel Almagro Cabañas (Mijas Las Lagunas) Substitution at 66'
David Serrano (Real Jaén) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Mauro Cabello Marín (Real Jaen CF) Substitution at 71'
Javier Gámez Zotano (Mijas Las Lagunas) Substitution at 73'
Goal! Mijas Las Lagunas 1, Real Jaén 2. Raúl Pérez (Mijas Las Lagunas) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Óscar Lozano (Real Jaén) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Busi (Real Jaén) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
